plain_description.what: On LiveCodeBench (coding problems, 26 models), a label-free tree is built on problem texts. The test asks whether some models do unusually well or badly in particular tree regions, beyond overall problem difficulty and input format. It is a pre-check before paying for a specialised-judge experiment.
plain_description.why: Per-cell evaluation and specialised judges only pay off if models really have region-specific strengths on this corpus.
plain_description.information: Result (no new calls): STOP. No model-by-region effect was found on the training side. A later power check corrected the original claim: at the actual design the test could only reliably detect effects larger than about 0.30 logit SD, so it is uninformative about smaller ones. This is bounded, never 'no interaction'. The judged stage is not run on LiveCodeBench. This covers this corpus, roster and tree recipe only.
